title: Comprehensive Comparisons of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms in Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.19429v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive comparison of four representative reinforcement learning (RL) methods in autonomous vehicle (AV) decision-making, including: Fitted Value Iteration (FVI), Rollout Classification Policy Iteration (RCPI), Deep Q-Network (DQN), and a discrete-action adaptation of Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (D-DDPG). The four methods are applied to the same AV decision-making problem at an unsignalized intersection and are compared in terms of optimality and safety, training stability, and training and decision cost. RCPI is the closest to a reference solution and has the most stable training process. However, it is the least data-efficient. D-DDPG reaches the second-smallest gap to a reference solution with the highest data efficiency, but has the least training stability. DQN is the most stable model-free method but has the highest collision rate. FVI achieves a lower collision rate than DQN, but is less data-eff

translated_title: 自动驾驶中强化学习算法的综合比较
translated_abstract: 本文对四种具有代表性的强化学习方法在自动驾驶汽车（AV）决策中的应用进行了全面比较，包括：拟合值迭代、滚动分类策略迭代（RCPI）、深度Q网络（DQN）以及离散动作版的深度确定性策略梯度（D-DDPG）。这四种方法被应用于无信号交叉口的同一自动驾驶决策问题，并从最优性与安全性、训练稳定性以及训练与决策成本等方面进行了比较。结果表明：RCPI最接近参考解且训练过程最稳定，但其数据效率最低；D-DDPG与参考解的差距第二小且数据效率最高，但训练稳定性最差；DQN是最稳定的无模型方法，但碰撞率最高；FVI的碰撞率低于DQN，但数据效率较低。
tldr: 本文在无信号交叉口的自动驾驶决策问题上，对FVI、RCPI、DQN和D-DDPG四种强化学习算法在最优性、安全性、训练稳定性和计算成本方面进行了全面比较，发现RCPI最接近参考解且训练最稳定但数据效率最低，而D-DDPG数据效率最高但稳定性最差。
en_tdlr: This paper comprehensively compares four reinforcement learning algorithms (FVI, RCPI, DQN, and D-DDPG) for autonomous vehicle decision-making at unsignalized intersections in terms of optimality, safety, training stability, and cost, finding that RCPI is closest to the reference solution with the most stable training but lowest data efficiency, while D-DDPG achieves the highest data efficiency with the least stability.
